capabilities: Manage nested to-do lists with colors, icons, and drag-and-drop ordering
Track tasks with optional start and due dates and Markdown descriptions with note links
Password-protect lists with AES-256-GCM encrypted storage that locks after inactivity
Sync tasks with Yandex, Google, iCloud, Nextcloud and other CalDAV calendars and .ics subscriptions
View tasks and external calendar events on a monthly calendar page with per-list filters
disambiguation: Not an RPG quest tracker; 'quests' here just means to-do tasks in a general task manager.
extras: Installable only via BRAT or manual download from releases; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Forgotten passwords for locked lists cannot be recovered; Google sync sign-in works only on desktop.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structured to-do manager with nested lists, task dates, attachments, and two-way sync with external calendar services.

relations.evidence: Google Calendar (with your own OAuth "Desktop app" client, see the steps above)
Yandex Calendar and other CalDAV servers (iCloud, Nextcloud, Fastmail), Google Calendar

requires.name: Calendar service account (Google, Yandex, iCloud, Nextcloud, Fastmail)
Google OAuth Desktop client ID and secret

summary: To-do list manager with nested and password-protected lists, start and due dates, attachments, a calendar page, and sync with Google, Yandex and CalDAV calendars.
